senses.gloss: (b. h.;Shaf. of הפך) [to invert,] to pour; to empty.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:8">Lam. R. to IV, 11</cite> <he>מזמר אני שהפך חופתו</he> … <he>ולא ש׳ חמתו וכ׳</he> I sing, because he (the king) has upset his son’s bridal chamber, but has not poured out his anger over his son; <he>שש׳ הקב״ה … ולא ש׳</he> because the Lord has poured his anger over wood and stone, and did not pour it out over Israel.

<cite ref="Yevamot 75b:9">Yeb. 75ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 23:2">Deut. XXIII, 2</cite>) <he>מי שע״י כריתה שׁוֹפֵךְ</he> he who pours (semen, instead of shooting forth, <he>מקלח</he>) in consequence of cutting.

Y. Sabb. XII, end, 13ᵈ וכתב לא השופך ‘and he writes’ (Deut. XXIV, 3), but not ‘he pours’ (a chemical fluid over a sympathetic writing to make it legible); ib. שופך דיו וכ׳ he pours ink in which there is no gall-nut, and this catches (settles on) the written letters; Y. Gitt. II, 44ᵇ top שָׁפֵיךְ (Chald.); a. fr.—ש׳ דמים to shed blood.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 58b">B. Mets. 58ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00095"><he>לָבַן</he> II</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII, 16</cite> <cite ref="U00504"><he>שופכין</he></cite>, read: <he>שׁוֹפְתִין</he>, v. <cite ref="U01812"><he>שָׁפַת</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Chullin 47b:11">Ḥull. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>ריאה  שׁנִשְׁפְּכָה כקיתון</he> a lung which (by tearing the membrane) is emptied like a ladle.

<cite ref="Sotah 42b:11">Sot. 42ᵇ</cite> (play on <cite ref="U00503"><he>שופך</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="U00318"><he>שׁוֹבַךְ</he></cite>) <he>שכל הרואה אותו נ׳ לפניו וכ׳</he> whoever saw him, was poured out before him like a ladle (his courage failed him, cmp. <cite ref="M01978"><he>מָסַס</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Pesachim 22b:1">Pes. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>דם שנ׳ כמים וכ׳</he> blood that is poured out like water makes susceptible of uncleanness.
<cite ref="Pesachim 22a:10">Ib. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>כמים הנִשְׁפָּכִין</he> like water that is poured out (ordinary water), opp. <he>המתנסכין</he> used for libation.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 8:7">Zeb. VIII, 7</cite>, sq. <he>יִשָּׁפֵךְ לאמה</he> shall be poured into the sewer; a. fr.

<cite ref="Yoma 68b:2">Yoma 68ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>שפך</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 4:12">Lev. IV, 12</cite>) <he>שיהא מקומו מש׳</he> the place for the ashes must be sloping; Sifra Vayikra, Hob., Par. 3, ch. V; <cite ref="Zevachim 106a:3">Zeb. 106ᵃ</cite>
